name: QIDI Q2 Safe Controls
description: Template for an iPhone Apple Shortcut using a Home Assistant or HTTPS webhook bridge.
notes: The printer displays a one-time pairing code and a fresh short-lived challenge for sensitive actions. Codes are printer-bound, expire, are single-use where applicable, and are never logged. Shortcuts cannot provide a guaranteed endless background loop. Use the Home Assistant blueprint for continuous five-minute polling. This template contains no secrets and does not call a printer.
